name: What types of fire features can AKN Design Group integrate into an outdoor living space?

mainEntity.name: What types of fire features can AKN Design Group integrate into an outdoor living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in designing and building a range of custom fire features, including built-in fire pits and outdoor fireplaces, as part of comprehensive outdoor living space renovations. These elements enhance both the aesthetics and functionality of your backyard, creating focal points for gathering and relaxation. When considering your options, a key decision factor is balancing the desired ambiance with the practical use of the space; for instance, a built-in fire pit offers an open, communal feel, while an outdoor fireplace can provide a more structured architectural element and warmth for cooler evenings.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group integrates custom built-in fire pits and outdoor fireplaces into high-end outdoor living spaces, enhancing ambiance and functionality.
